connector.name: Token Of Esteem
connector.registryDescription: A press your agent can commission: a funny, personalized printed booklet, mailed as a gift.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.tokenofesteem.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.tokenofesteem, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer toe_live_... account token, issued at tokenofesteem.com/account. Use toe_test_... for the free sandbox. No account? See the tokenless 402 path at tokenofesteem.com/for-agents.
